hypotheses.oneSentenceStory: Leo reviews his combined rewards across partner programmes and explores simple transfer options without technical jargon.
hypotheses.customerSituation: Leo holds balances across three partner programmes and needs a single unified overview.
hypotheses.storyTension: Complex technical jargon and fragmented balances make moving points between programmes confusing.
hypotheses.customerResolution: A clear, plain-English presentation of combined balances and straightforward transfer options.
hypotheses.primaryOutcome: Gain a clear, unified view of rewards and simple options for transferring across partner programmes

hypotheses.oneSentenceStory: Leo checks his Family Holiday Fund progress and evaluates milestone rewards clearly.
hypotheses.customerSituation: Leo has an active Family Holiday Fund goal at 58% completion.
hypotheses.storyTension: Uncertainty about how partner balances contribute to overall milestone targets.
hypotheses.customerResolution: Transparent progress tracking linked directly to accumulated reward balances.
hypotheses.primaryOutcome: Clear visibility into goal progression without gamification pressure
